facts.fact: Morocco's CNDP, headed by president Omar Seghrouchni, signed a memorandum of understanding in Lisbon with Portugal's CNPD, per a CNDP communique reported 24 November 2026.
facts.system: Commission nationale de contrôle de la protection des données à caractère personnel (CNDP)

facts.fact: Morocco's CNDP, headed by president Omar Seghrouchni, is acting as the data protection authority, signing a memorandum with Portugal's CNPD that includes sharing best practice on control and implementation of the legal framework.

MAR.note: The only agreement is with Portugal, outside Africa; the African data protection network RAPDP is named only as a network the CNDP has relations with, not as membership.
